An '''expedition to Lehon''' was an exploratory mission to the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] that was mounted by a team of [[sentientologist|anthropologist]]s. Taking place after approximately [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]], the expedition discovered that the Rakata [[Species/Legends|species]] had seemingly perished.<ref name="TEA" />
